effects: The signer sends `_underlying` USDe to the vault, using the signer's USDe allowance to the vault.
The vault deposits that USDe into sUSDe and mints stk-USDe shares to `receiver`.
The vault keeps a deposit fee: it mints part of the new shares to `config.feeRecipient`, so the receiver gets fewer shares.
Before the deposit, `_harvest` mints management and performance fee shares to the fee recipient. This dilutes existing holders.
formats.shown: Intent 'Deposit', with the USDe amount, the stk-USDe ticker as a constant, and the address that receives the shares.

findings.title: deposit does not show the number of stk-USDe shares received, which a storage fee rate reduces
findings.evidence: AllocatorVaultV3.deposit: `uint256 userShares = (newShares * (MAX_BPS - config.depositFee)) / MAX_BPS;` `_mint(config.feeRecipient, feeShares);`. Case 0: the signer receives 7929090223291065430379033034 stk-USDe, but the screen shows only 'Share ticker: stk-USDe'.
findings.fix: No descriptor change can show the share count, because the vault computes it from storage. You can add 'after fees' to a label.

findings.title: deposit intent 'Deposit' names neither the asset nor the vault share received
findings.evidence: descriptor deposit format: `"intent": "Deposit"`, with no interpolatedIntent.
findings.fix: Change the intent to "Deposit USDe for stk-USDe".

cases.notes: 9644.046 USDe leaves and is shown right. 7929090223.29 stk-USDe arrive to the signer: the asset and the receiver are shown, the amount is not. The USDe allowance spent equals the amount shown. The reader only guessed that an approval was needed.

effects: The signer sends an amount of USDe that the vault computes with previewMint. This amount includes the deposit fee, and nothing in the calldata caps it.
The vault mints exactly `shares` stk-USDe to `receiver`.
The vault mints extra fee shares to `config.feeRecipient`, and the signer pays for them in USDe.
`_harvest` mints fee shares to the fee recipient first.
formats.shown: Intent 'Mint', with 'Deposit asset: USDe' as a constant ticker, the number of stk-USDe shares, and the receiver.

findings.title: mint does not show how much USDe leaves the signer, and no bound caps that amount
findings.evidence: AllocatorVaultV3.mint: `uint256 _underlying = previewMint(shares); ... IERC20(underlying).safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), _underlying);`. The descriptor field 'Deposit asset' only shows the constant `underlyingTicker`.
findings.fix: No calldata value holds the USDe cost. Change the label to 'Pays in (amount set by vault)' to make this clear.

findings.title: mint intent 'Mint' does not say that USDe leaves the wallet
findings.evidence: descriptor mint format: `"intent": "Mint"`. The USDe payment appears only as the raw constant field 'Deposit asset'.
findings.fix: Change the intent to "Deposit USDe to mint stk-USDe".

effects: The vault burns stk-USDe shares from `owner`. It computes the number with ceiling rounding, and nothing in the calldata caps it.
If the signer is not the owner, the vault spends the owner's stk-USDe allowance to the signer.
With `config.hasCooldown` set (the live state, see case 1), `receiver` gets sUSDe worth `_underlying` USDe, not USDe.
Without cooldown, `receiver` gets `_underlying` USDe from sUSDe.
`_harvest` mints fee shares to the fee recipient first.
formats.shown: Intent 'Withdraw', with 'Withdraw exactly' X USDe, the receiver and the owner.

findings.title: withdraw shows 'Withdraw exactly X USDe', but the receiver gets sUSDe
findings.evidence: AllocatorVaultV3.withdraw: `uint256 assets = strategy.previewWithdraw(_underlying); ... if (config.hasCooldown) { IERC20(address(strategy)).safeTransfer(receiver, assets); }`. The descriptor field reads `"label": "Withdraw exactly"` with `"token": "$.metadata.constants.underlyingToken"` (USDe). Case 1 (redeem, same branch) shows the vault sending sUSDe, so hasCooldown is on.
findings.fix: Change the intent to "Withdraw sUSDe worth USDe amount". Change the label to 'USDe value to withdraw (paid in sUSDe)'. You can also add a constant field 'Receive asset: sUSDe'.

findings.title: withdraw does not show how many stk-USDe shares the vault burns from the owner
findings.evidence: AllocatorVaultV3.withdraw: `uint256 shares = _convertToShares(assets, true); ... _burn(owner, shares);`. No max-shares parameter exists.

formats.key: redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address owner)
effects: The vault burns `shares` stk-USDe from `owner`. If the signer is not the owner, it spends the owner's allowance to the signer.
With `config.hasCooldown` set, the vault sends sUSDe (the strategy shares) to `receiver`, not USDe.
The amount received comes from the vault exchange rate after `_harvest` mints fee shares. It has no minimum.
formats.shown: Intent 'Redeem', with the stk-USDe shares to redeem, the receiver and the owner. Nothing says which asset arrives.

findings.title: redeem does not show that the signer receives sUSDe; the reader expected USDe
findings.evidence: AllocatorVaultV3.redeem: `if (config.hasCooldown) { IERC20(address(strategy)).safeTransfer(receiver, assets); }`. Case 1: the signer receives 1626.3125 sUSDe (0x9d39…3497). The screen shows only 'Shares to redeem', 'To' and 'Owner'. The reader believed 'Underlying asset (likely USDe)'.
findings.fix: Change the intent to "Redeem stk-USDe for sUSDe". Add a constant field 'Receive asset: sUSDe' with a new constant `strategyTicker`.

findings.title: redeem has no minimum-received bound, and the sUSDe amount comes from storage
findings.evidence: AllocatorVaultV3.redeem: `uint256 assets = _convertToAssets(shares, false);` after `_harvest()`. No calldata parameter bounds `assets`.

cases.notes: 1632128188.76 stk-USDe burned from the signer, shown right. 1626.31 sUSDe arrive. The screen names no asset, so the reader expected USDe.
